## harness init

Create .harness/project.yaml for a repository, using the detected technology profiles,
add .harness/ to .gitignore and write an example task. Prints the detected profiles and the
next commands.

```text
harness init [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--force` | flag | no | false | Replace an existing project configuration |
| `--gitignore`, `--no-gitignore` | flag | no | --gitignore | Add .harness/ to the project's .gitignore (state, artifacts and copies of the code live there) |
| `--example-task`, `--no-example-task` | flag | no | --example-task | Write an example task to .harness/task.example.yaml |
| `--agent-skills` | flag | no | false | Also write the skill of the governed flow for Claude Code (.claude/skills/harness/SKILL.md) and Codex (.codex/skills/harness/SKILL.md) |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

## harness inspect

Detect the technology profiles of a repository (read-only), with confidence and
evidence.

```text
harness inspect [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

## harness doctor

Check the local environment (Python and Git required; Node.js and npm reported as
NOT_APPLICABLE when absent; Git identity reported) and, with --path, the project: its
configuration, the agent CLI of the configured provider on PATH, the agent sandbox mechanism,
the validators, the baseline commit and whether .harness/ is ignored by Git. Each check that
is not PASSED says how to fix it. Exit code 2 when a required check FAILED; a WARNING does
not fail.

```text
harness doctor [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | path | no |  | Also validate the project in this directory |
| `--install-hooks` | flag | no | false | Run the hook installation command the project declares (environment.gitHooks.install) before the checks |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

## harness do

Make a change from TEXT in one command: create the task (the text is its intent and,
without --criterion, its acceptance criterion), run it and, on a terminal, answer INTENT's
questions and show the decision brief and ask for the decision. No task file is needed.
Small, risk-free tasks take the fast lane (`friction.fastLane`). With --pre-approve the
approval you give now is applied only when the gate passed, there is no risk factor and the
task is size S. Exit codes as `run start`: 0 closed, 4 a decision is pending, 6 stopped.

```text
harness do [OPTIONS] {text}
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | str | yes |  |  |
| `--criterion` | str | no |  | An acceptance criterion (repeatable; default: the text itself) |
| `--owned` | str | no |  | A workspace path the change may touch (repeatable) |
| `--title` | str | no |  | Task title (default: first line) |
| `--provider` | str | no |  | Agent provider id; defaults to the project agentProvider |
| `--pre-approve` | flag | no | false | Approve in advance (friction.preAuthorization): applied at DECISION only if the gate passed, the ChangeSet has no risk factor and the task is size S |
| `--pre-approve-hours` | int range | no |  | Validity of the pre-authorised approval |
| `--actor` | str | no |  | Identifier of the person acting (recorded, not authenticated). Defaults to the Git user under governance.deciderIdentity: git, otherwise human.local. Ids of agents, validators and the harness (agent.*, validator.*, harness.*) are refused with exit code 5. |
| `--interactive`, `--no-interactive` | flag | no | --interactive | On a terminal, answer the questions and decide in the same command |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

## harness check

Run the validators of the gate and the enabled diff checks on the workspace, without
recording anything (`runtime.gateContract`). The agent can run it before it finishes; the
implement request carries the exact command. Exit 0 when every mandatory validator passes
and no enforced check reports a blocking problem, 6 otherwise.

```text
harness check [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | no |  | Run whose task and baseline the diff checks use (default: the latest run that wrote a check state) |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

## harness status

Show the full status projection of a run: phases, validations, findings, gate, human
decision, event-chain check and metrics.

```text
harness status [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | no | `latest` | Run (execution) identifier, `latest` or a unique prefix such as run_1a2b |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

## harness trace

Export the trace of a run as Markdown, JSON, JSONL, SARIF or a GitLab Code Quality
report (codequality: the findings, with the same fingerprints as SARIF). Under
`governance.verifyRecords: true` the run is verified first (as `harness verify`) and a run
that does not verify is not exported (exit code 6).

```text
harness trace [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | no | `latest` | Run (execution) identifier, `latest` or a unique prefix such as run_1a2b |
| `--format` | str | no | `markdown` | markdown, json, jsonl, sarif or codequality |
| `--output` | path | no |  | Write to this file instead of standard output |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness verify

Verify the record of a run (or of every run): the event chain, the head of the chain
against its anchor outside .harness (`governance.chainAnchor`), every record that has an
event against that event, the execution's pointers and every referenced artifact against its
digest. Prints a report and never repairs anything. With --bundle, verify an evidence bundle
of `harness export` instead: its entries against the manifest, the event chain, the artifacts
and the decision records. Exit code 0 when everything verifies, 6 when any check fails, 3 for
an unknown run or bundle.

```text
harness verify [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | no |  | Run (execution) identifier; without it, every run of the workspace |
| `--bundle` | file | no |  | Verify a portable evidence bundle instead (no workspace needed) |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness export

Export a run as a portable evidence bundle: its event chain, records, every artifact they
reference and a manifest with the digest of each entry. `harness verify --bundle` and
`harness verify-approval --bundle` check it without the workspace. A run whose event chain
does not verify is not exported (exit code 5; 6 under `governance.verifyRecords` when the
record does not verify).

```text
harness export [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--bundle` | file | yes |  | Write the portable evidence bundle (tar.gz) here |
| `--run` | str | no | `latest` | Run (execution) identifier, `latest` or a unique prefix such as run_1a2b |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness verify-approval

Check in CI that the range --base..--head is a ChangeSet a person approved: recompute its
ChangeSet digest from the two revisions and require an unexpired APPROVE or
APPROVE_EXCEPTION bound to that digest in a bundle (or the workspace record). Any other
change in the range fails. Exit code 0 when it passes, 5 when no approval matches.

```text
harness verify-approval [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--base` | str | yes |  | Revision the change starts from (the pull request base) |
| `--head` | str | no | `HEAD` | Revision to verify (the merged tree) |
| `--bundle` | path | no |  | Evidence bundle with the approval (repeatable) |
| `--workspace`, `--no-workspace` | flag | no | --workspace | Also look for the approval in the workspace's .harness/state.db |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Repository directory |

## harness gc

Apply the retention settings to runs that ended (closed, cancelled or rejected) longer
ago than them: `retention.artifactDays` deletes the run's artifacts that no kept run uses and
records a `retention.artifacts.pruned` event; `retention.eventDays` removes the run, its
events, records and artifacts. Open runs and memory records are never touched. Without
--apply only the report is printed.

```text
harness gc [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--apply` | flag | no | false | Delete what the report lists; without it nothing is deleted |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness inbox

List the runs of the project that wait for a person, oldest first: a decision in
DECISION (gate status, digest, blocking findings) or answers to clarification questions in
INTENT, each with the next command. With --approve, --reject, --request-changes,
--decisions or --batch it records several decisions, each bound to its own ChangeSet digest:
a stale digest or a refused decision is reported for that run (the others are recorded) and
the command exits 5 when any was refused.

```text
harness inbox [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |
| `--approve` | str | no |  | Batch: APPROVE a run as RUN=sha256:DIGEST, the digest the inbox shows (repeatable) |
| `--reject` | str | no |  | Batch: REJECT a run as RUN=sha256:DIGEST (repeatable) |
| `--request-changes` | str | no |  | Batch: REQUEST_CHANGES on a run as RUN=sha256:DIGEST (repeatable) |
| `--decisions` | file | no |  | Batch file (YAML or JSON): a list of run, decision, changeSetDigest and an optional rationale |
| `--batch` | flag | no | false | On a terminal: decide every pending decision of the inbox one after the other |
| `--rationale` | str | no |  | Batch: the rationale recorded with each decision |
| `--actor` | str | no |  | Identifier of the person acting (recorded, not authenticated). Defaults to the Git user under governance.deciderIdentity: git, otherwise human.local. Ids of agents, validators and the harness (agent.*, validator.*, harness.*) are refused with exit code 5. |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness metrics

Local metrics of the governed runs, with zero model calls: tokens (input, output, cache)
and cost by agent, model, task and phase, models used, lines by agent invocation and by
person, issues resolved and features delivered, time per task, phase, agent call and human
wait, quality, friction against the targets per size and daily and weekly trends. Costs of
providers that report only tokens are estimated from the price table and labelled
estimated. The HTML file is self-contained (inline CSS and SVG, nothing fetched). No
per-person indicator is computed.

```text
harness metrics [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--format` | str | no |  | html, md, json, csv (one row per run) or prometheus; printed, or written to --output. Without it, metrics.json, metrics.md and metrics.html are written to --output-dir |
| `--output` | path | no |  | File for --format |
| `--output-dir` | path | no |  | Directory of the three files written without --format (default .harness/metrics) |
| `--open` | flag | no | false | Open the HTML report in the default browser |
| `--since` | str | no |  | Only runs created since DATE (YYYY-MM-DD, ISO 8601, 7d, 2w, 12h) |
| `--task` | str | no |  | Only the runs of this task |
| `--model` | str | no |  | Only agent calls of this model |
| `--agent` | str | no |  | Only agent calls of this agent provider id |
| `--all-repos` | flag | no | false | Every repository of the run registry (runtime.stateDir), not only this one |
| `--prices` | file | no |  | Price table (YAML or JSON, USD per million input, output and cache tokens by model id) for providers that report tokens without a cost; overrides metrics.prices |
| `--narrative` | flag | no | false | Add a narrative summary: one call to metrics.narrative.command, on demand |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness registry

List the projects whose run registry lives in the state directory
(`runtime.stateDir: auto`, `$HARNESS_STATE_DIR` or the user's data directory) with their
latest runs: the runs of several repositories in one place.

```text
harness registry [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

## harness review-code

Review a change with the review panel outside a governed run: reviewers by domain over
diff slices, the layered rule catalog, a fixed output contract and a verdict the harness
recomputes. Rules a tool verifies never reach a model; reviewers run only on their
signals; answers are cached. A passing review is recorded as refs/harness/review/pass/SHA
(or pass-warn). Exit code 6 when the verdict is FAIL or UNKNOWN (under review.panel.mode
enforce) or when hook mode cannot fetch the base.

```text
harness review-code [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--mode` | str | no | `manual` | manual: the branch against its base; hook: the same, fetching the base first (a failed fetch aborts); staged: the index against HEAD |
| `--base` | str | no |  | Base branch or commit; default: the pull or merge request base of the CI, the branch convention (review.panel.baseBranches), then the default branch |
| `--head` | str | no | `HEAD` | The commit to review (manual and hook) |
| `--provider` | str | no |  | Provider of the reviewers (an agentProviders id or simulated) |
| `--fallback-provider` | str | no |  | Provider of the one retry after an invalid answer |
| `--model` | str | no |  | Force one model for every reviewer |
| `--skip` | str | no |  | A reviewer id to skip (repeatable) |
| `--pull-request` | int | no |  | Pull or merge request number for the comment (default: from the CI environment) |
| `--comment`, `--no-comment` | flag | no |  | Post one comment per passing result on the pull or merge request (default: review.panel.comment) |
| `--cache`, `--no-cache` | flag | no | --cache | Use the review cache |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

## harness retrospect

Derive non-mutating observations and recommendations from a closed run. Nothing is
applied automatically.

```text
harness retrospect [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | no | `latest` | Run (execution) identifier, `latest` or a unique prefix such as run_1a2b |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness config validate

Validate the project configuration and print the resolved profiles, workflow,
validators, capabilities and policies, the settings that are declared but not applied
(`declarative`) and a warning for each one the project relies on (`warnings`).

```text
harness config validate [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

## harness config lint

Report contradictions between the harness configuration and the agent instruction files
(AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, .cursor/rules, .github/copilot-instructions.md): tool
versions, coverage thresholds, statements about the tests and instructions to bypass a
control (--no-verify, a forced push, git add -A). Each conflict names the source that wins by
`instructions.precedence`. Exit 6 when there is any issue.

```text
harness config lint [OPTIONS]
```

## harness task create

Validate a task file (YAML or JSON) and persist it as a versioned task. A task needs
at least one acceptance criterion (exit code 2 otherwise), except under
`intake.criteriaPolicy: enforce`: there a task without criteria is stored with
`criteriaPending: true` and INTENT asks for its criteria (rule C0). Under
`governance.pinTaskRevision: true` a task id that has an open run is refused with exit code 5:
revise it with `task clarify` during INTENT or use a new id.

```text
harness task create [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--file` | file | yes |  | Task file (YAML or JSON) |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

## harness task clarify

Answer the open clarification questions of a task and store the revised task. Run
`harness run continue` afterwards to assess the revision in INTENT. An unknown question id
or an empty answer exits with 2, no open request with 3, and a task with a run past INTENT
or an actor id of an agent, validator or the harness with 5.

```text
harness task clarify [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--task` | str | yes |  | Task identifier (taskId) |
| `--file` | file | yes |  | Answers file (YAML or JSON): answers by question id, optional criteria and requirement changes |
| `--actor` | str | no |  | Identifier of the person acting (recorded, not authenticated). Defaults to the Git user under governance.deciderIdentity: git, otherwise human.local. Ids of agents, validators and the harness (agent.*, validator.*, harness.*) are refused with exit code 5. |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness task confirm

Confirm the operational contract of a task's current revision, bound to its digest
(`intake.operationalContract`). Under `enforce` INTENT waits for it; then `harness run
continue`. With --pre-approve the same act records an approval in advance bound to the
contract digest and the condition gate passed, no risk factor, size S. A stale digest, a
non-human actor or --pre-approve without `friction.preAuthorization.mode: allow` exits 5.

```text
harness task confirm [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--task` | str | yes |  | Task identifier (taskId) |
| `--digest` | str | yes |  | Digest of the operational contract shown by task questions |
| `--actor` | str | no |  | Identifier of the person acting (recorded, not authenticated). Defaults to the Git user under governance.deciderIdentity: git, otherwise human.local. Ids of agents, validators and the harness (agent.*, validator.*, harness.*) are refused with exit code 5. |
| `--pre-approve` | flag | no | false | Under friction.preAuthorization: also approve the run in advance, applied at DECISION only if the gate passed, the ChangeSet has no risk factor and the task is size S; otherwise you are asked as usual |
| `--pre-approve-hours` | int range | no |  | Validity of the pre-authorised approval in hours (default friction.preAuthorization.defaultHours, at most maxHours) |
| `--rationale` | str | no | `` | Why you approve in advance (recorded with --pre-approve) |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness run start

Create a run for a task and execute the normative phases until a stop condition. Exit
code 4 means the automated phases finished and a human decision is pending; 6 means a
validation, policy or blocking condition stopped the run. With --isolate worktree a branch or
worktree directory that already exists stops the run (exit 6); nothing is reset or deleted.

```text
harness run start [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--task` | str | yes |  | Task identifier (taskId) |
| `--provider` | str | no |  | Agent provider id; defaults to the project agentProvider |
| `--isolate` | str | no |  | worktree: run in a Git worktree of its own on a new branch from the updated base branch; none: in place (default: workspace.isolation.mode) |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

## harness gate decide

Record a human decision bound to the current ChangeSet digest. A decision for a stale
digest, or APPROVE over a gate that did not pass, is rejected with exit code 5. On a
terminal, omitting --decision, --change-set-digest or --rationale shows the decision brief,
asks for the missing values and asks the person to type the start of the digest the decision
binds to; a digest that is not confirmed records nothing (exit 5). Without a terminal the
three options are required (exit 2). Under `governance.confirmDecisionDigest: true` the
same confirmation is asked on a terminal even when every option is given. An actor id of an
agent, validator or the harness is refused with exit 5; without --actor the decider is the
Git user under `governance.deciderIdentity: git` (human.local, with a warning, when Git has
no identity).

```text
harness gate decide [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | yes |  | Run (execution) identifier, `latest` or a unique prefix such as run_1a2b |
| `--decision` | `APPROVE` \| `REJECT` \| `REQUEST_CHANGES` \| `APPROVE_EXCEPTION` | no |  | Human decision; asked interactively when omitted on a terminal |
| `--change-set-digest` | str | no |  | Current ChangeSet digest shown by status or review (sha256:...); confirmed interactively when omitted on a terminal |
| `--rationale` | str | no |  | Justification recorded with the decision; asked interactively when omitted |
| `--actor` | str | no |  | Identifier of the person acting (recorded, not authenticated). Defaults to the Git user under governance.deciderIdentity: git, otherwise human.local. Ids of agents, validators and the harness (agent.*, validator.*, harness.*) are refused with exit code 5. |
| `--continue`, `--no-continue` | flag | no | --continue | Resume the run after recording the decision |
| `--expires-in` | str | no |  | APPROVE_EXCEPTION under review.exceptions: validity such as 14d, 36h or 2w (default review.exceptionDays) |
| `--expires-at` | str | no |  | APPROVE_EXCEPTION: ISO 8601 instant the exception expires |
| `--scope` | str | no |  | APPROVE_EXCEPTION: findings covered, as rule or rule:path (repeatable; default: the blocking findings of the gate, by fingerprint) |
| `--alternative-evidence` | str | no |  | APPROVE_EXCEPTION: evidence that compensates for the blocking findings |
| `--follow-up` | str | no |  | APPROVE_EXCEPTION: issue or task that will remove the exception |
| `--interactive`, `-i` | flag | no | false | Show the decision brief and confirm the ChangeSet digest even when every option is given |
| `--acknowledge-risk` | str | no |  | APPROVE or APPROVE_EXCEPTION under verification.riskFactors: a risk factor of the ChangeSet the decider acknowledges (repeatable; required for every factor whose action is acknowledge) |
| `--check` | str | no |  | Under review.manualChecklist: a checklist item the person verified (repeatable); APPROVE needs every item of the run |
| `--change-request` | str | no |  | REQUEST_CHANGES under review.structuredChanges: a blocking item as 'description::condition' where the condition is test:NODE_ID (a pytest node id), absent:REGEX or text (repeatable) |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

Accept, edit or reject a retrospective recommendation. The decision is kept as
retrospective memory: an accepted or edited recommendation enters the context of later
runs, a rejected one stays as history. A second decision on the same recommendation exits
with code 5; nothing is applied to rules, gates or configuration.

| `--recommendation` | str | yes |  | Recommendation identifier shown by retrospect |
| `--decision` | `ACCEPT` \| `EDIT` \| `REJECT` | yes |  | Decision on the recommendation |
| `--rationale` | str | yes |  | Justification recorded with the decision |

Approve or reject the proposed decomposition, bound to its digest. APPROVE runs the
sub-tasks in order, each with its own verification and gate; REJECT keeps the task whole.
A stale digest, a non-human actor or a decision other than APPROVE or REJECT exits 5. An
APPROVE with --no-continue exits 0 once it is recorded, as gate decide does.


| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | yes |  | Run (execution) identifier, `latest` or a unique prefix such as run_1a2b |
| `--decision` | `APPROVE` \| `REJECT` \| `REQUEST_CHANGES` \| `APPROVE_EXCEPTION` | yes |  | APPROVE or REJECT |
| `--digest` | str | yes |  | Digest of the proposed plan shown by plan show |
| `--rationale` | str | yes |  | Justification recorded |
| `--actor` | str | no |  | Identifier of the person acting (recorded, not authenticated). Defaults to the Git user under governance.deciderIdentity: git, otherwise human.local. Ids of agents, validators and the harness (agent.*, validator.*, harness.*) are refused with exit code 5. |
| `--continue`, `--no-continue` | flag | no | --continue | Resume the run after recording the decision |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

| `--digest` | str | yes |  | Digest shown by acceptance show |
| `--rationale` | str | yes |  | Justification recorded |
| `--actor` | str | no |  | Identifier of the person acting (recorded, not authenticated). Defaults to the Git user under governance.deciderIdentity: git, otherwise human.local. Ids of agents, validators and the harness (agent.*, validator.*, harness.*) are refused with exit code 5. |
| `--continue`, `--no-continue` | flag | no | --continue | Resume the run after recording the decision |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness budget show

Show the usage of a run and of its task (reported tokens and cost, measured wall time of
the agent calls) against the `budget` limits, the limits a person raised and what remains.

```text
harness budget show [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | yes |  | Run (execution) identifier, `latest` or a unique prefix such as run_1a2b |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness budget raise

Raise a budget limit of a run blocked with budget.exceeded; the raise is recorded on the
run's event chain with the person and the rationale, then `harness run continue` resumes the
run. A non-human actor, a lower limit or a missing rationale exits 5.

```text
harness budget raise [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | yes |  | Run (execution) identifier, `latest` or a unique prefix such as run_1a2b |
| `--scope` | str | yes |  | call, task or run |
| `--metric` | str | yes |  | costUsd, tokens or wallSeconds |
| `--to` | float | yes |  | The new limit; it must be above the current |
| `--rationale` | str | yes |  | Justification recorded |
| `--actor` | str | no |  | Identifier of the person acting (recorded, not authenticated). Defaults to the Git user under governance.deciderIdentity: git, otherwise human.local. Ids of agents, validators and the harness (agent.*, validator.*, harness.*) are refused with exit code 5. |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness routing calibrate

Report the cost per approved task of every routing decision recorded in the project
(`agentRouting`), by provider family, call kind, task size, model and effort, and suggest
the cheapest implement rung per size among groups with at least two approved runs. Nothing
is applied: a person edits `agentRouting.tables`.

```text
harness routing calibrate [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness pr publish

Post the decision brief of a run on a pull or merge request (one comment per run,
updated when published again) and attach the run's findings: SARIF to GitHub code scanning,
a Code Insights report on Bitbucket; GitLab and Azure DevOps read the report from CI
artifacts. GitHub is the default; another forge is detected from the origin remote or set
with --forge or delivery.forge. Information only: nothing is decided on the forge.

```text
harness pr publish [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--pr` | int range | yes |  | Pull request number |
| `--run` | str | no | `latest` | Run (execution) identifier, `latest` or a unique prefix such as run_1a2b |
| `--repository` | str | no |  | owner/name (default: delivery.publisher or the origin remote) |
| `--transport` | str | no |  | gh (the GitHub CLI) or api (HTTPS with the token in delivery.publisher.tokenEnv, GITHUB_TOKEN by default) |
| `--sarif`, `--no-sarif` | flag | no |  | Upload the run's findings to code scanning |
| `--commit` | str | no |  | Commit the SARIF report belongs to (default: the PR head) |
| `--forge` | str | no |  | github, gitlab, bitbucket, azure-devops or gitea (default: delivery.forge, else detected from the origin remote) |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness pr create

Open a pull or merge request from the closure branch of a run (push the branch first),
with the repository's pull request template and the decision brief as its description and
the configured labels. The creation is recorded as a delivery.pull-request.created event.
Nothing is approved on the forge: the approval is the run's digest-bound decision.

```text
harness pr create [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | no | `latest` | Run (execution) identifier, `latest` or a unique prefix such as run_1a2b |
| `--base` | str | no |  | Target branch (default: delivery.forge.baseBranch) |
| `--head` | str | no |  | Source branch (default: the closure branch of the run) |
| `--title` | str | no |  | Title (default: the task title) |
| `--label` | str | no |  | Label, added to delivery.forge.labels (repeatable) |
| `--draft`, `--ready` | flag | no |  | Open it as a draft (default: delivery.forge.draft) |
| `--forge` | str | no |  | github, gitlab, bitbucket, azure-devops or gitea |
| `--repository` | str | no |  | Repository path on the forge (default: the origin remote) |
| `--transport` | str | no |  | cli (gh or glab) or api (HTTPS, token from the environment) |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness pr status

Set the commit status governed-harness from a run: success once it closed approved,
pending while it waits for a human decision, failure otherwise.

```text
harness pr status [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--commit` | str | yes |  | Commit whose status is set |
| `--run` | str | no | `latest` | Run (execution) identifier, `latest` or a unique prefix such as run_1a2b |
| `--target-url` | str | no |  | Link shown with the status (for example the CI job) |
| `--forge` | str | no |  | github, gitlab, bitbucket, azure-devops or gitea |
| `--repository` | str | no |  | Repository path on the forge (default: the origin remote) |
| `--transport` | str | no |  | cli (gh or glab) or api (HTTPS, token from the environment) |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness pr forge

Show the forge the workspace resolves to (delivery.forge or the origin remote), its API

```text
harness pr forge [OPTIONS]
```

## harness verification show

Show the verification plan of a run (the rung each criterion requires, the rungs this
environment reaches and why), its preflight (READY, PARTIAL or UNAVAILABLE), the
certification of its ChangeSet, the deferred items and the manual checklist.

```text
harness verification show [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | no | `latest` | Run (execution) identifier, `latest` or a unique prefix such as run_1a2b |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness verification decide

Decide on a run whose preflight is UNAVAILABLE: continue it uncertified for what this
environment cannot verify (those criteria end WAIVED, never certified; the unavailable probes
are not run). Recorded on the run with the person and the rationale. A run that does not
wait on such a preflight, or a non-human actor, exits 5.

```text
harness verification decide [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | yes |  | Run (execution) identifier, `latest` or a unique prefix such as run_1a2b |
| `--continue-uncertified` | flag | no | false | Continue without the rungs the preflight found unreachable (required) |
| `--rationale` | str | yes |  | Justification recorded |
| `--actor` | str | no |  | Identifier of the person acting (recorded, not authenticated). Defaults to the Git user under governance.deciderIdentity: git, otherwise human.local. Ids of agents, validators and the harness (agent.*, validator.*, harness.*) are refused with exit code 5. |
| `--continue`, `--no-continue` | flag | no | --continue | Resume the run after recording the decision |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness standards show

Show the language standards packs: the detected and effective packs (repository
overrides applied), their tools and the validators added for the tools the repository
configures; with --lang every card of one pack; with --file the cards selected for those
files. Works without a project configuration. Reads only.

```text
harness standards show [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--lang` | str | no |  | One pack (python, typescript, java, ...) with all its cards |
| `--file` | str | no |  | A workspace path: show the cards an implement call and the review checklist would get for it (repeatable) |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

## harness architecture show

Show the architecture of the project: the configured section, whether the project is
new or existing, the cached survey or the ADR, the layer rules in force with their
forbidden imports, and the source layout the survey cache is keyed by.

```text
harness architecture show [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

## harness architecture decide

Decide the architecture, bound to the digest of the proposal: approve or reject the
layer rules a survey inferred (existing project), or choose one of the options of a new
project, which is recorded as an ADR. The approved rules are enforced as forbidden
dependencies in VERIFICATION. A stale digest or a non-human actor exits 5.

```text
harness architecture decide [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | str | yes |  | Run (execution) identifier, `latest` or a unique prefix such as run_1a2b |
| `--digest` | str | yes |  | Digest shown by the blocked phase |
| `--rationale` | str | yes |  | Justification recorded |
| `--decision` | `APPROVE` \| `REJECT` \| `REQUEST_CHANGES` \| `APPROVE_EXCEPTION` | no |  | APPROVE or REJECT the layer rules a survey inferred |
| `--option` | str | no |  | The architecture option chosen for a new project |
| `--actor` | str | no |  | Identifier of the person acting (recorded, not authenticated). Defaults to the Git user under governance.deciderIdentity: git, otherwise human.local. Ids of agents, validators and the harness (agent.*, validator.*, harness.*) are refused with exit code 5. |
| `--continue`, `--no-continue` | flag | no | --continue | Resume the run after recording the decision |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness architecture refresh

Mark the cached architecture survey stale: the next run surveys the project again (one
call). Approved rules stay in force until a new survey is decided.

```text
harness architecture refresh [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness project show

Show what the harness detects about the project, deterministically and without an
agent call: new or existing (and why), profiles, standards packs, testing strategy,
architecture status, project setup answers and forge.

```text
harness project show [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

## harness mcp serve

Serve the harness to an agent session over stdio (Model Context Protocol, JSON-RPC 2.0,
one message per line). Tools: project, status, inbox, task create, questions and clarify
(the person's answers, marked as relayed), run start (provider session by default) and
continue, check, review and standards. No tool decides for a person: gate, acceptance,
plan and architecture decisions stay in the terminal. Register it, for example, with
claude mcp add harness -- harness mcp serve.

```text
harness mcp serve [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |

## harness review verify

Check the review evidence of a commit (refs/harness/review/pass/SHA or pass-warn)
without calling any model: the report is bound to the commit, its digest is intact and its
diff is the diff between its base and the commit. Exit code 6 when it does not verify.

```text
harness review verify [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--sha` | str | no | `HEAD` | The commit whose review evidence to check |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

## harness review variance

Run the same review several times without cache and report its variance: verdict
stability, how often each finding appears and the mean pairwise agreement (Jaccard). Every
run calls the reviewers again.

```text
harness review variance [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--runs` | int range | no | `3` | Identical reviews to run |
| `--mode` | str | no | `manual` | manual or staged |
| `--base` | str | no |  | Base branch or commit |
| `--provider` | str | no |  | Provider of the reviewers |
| `--model` | str | no |  | Force one model for every reviewer |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

## harness review rules show

Show the effective review rule catalog: the rules of the three layers (built-in,
language packs, project) after precedence and supersedes, the inactive rules and why, the
reviewers and the ones whose rules block drifted. Reads only.

```text

```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

## harness review rules sync

Write the generated rules block of every project reviewer (.harness/review/agents) from
the catalog, between its BEGIN and END markers; the only writer of that block. With
--check nothing is written and a drift exits with 6.

```text
harness review rules sync [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--check` | flag | no | false | Only report project reviewers whose rules block drifted (exit 6) |
| `--path` | path | no |  | Project directory |
| `--json`, `--no-json` | flag | no |  | Print JSON, or readable text with --no-json (default: JSON unless standard output is a terminal) |

Install a pre-push hook that runs harness review-code --mode hook: a FAIL or UNKNOWN
